name: 03-noisy-night-0f5fc80
description: IR AGC hunting all night (+-25% around a 3500 resting level) in genuine darkness (day pipeline railed at 8192). The pre-fix upward-only baseline drift ratcheted the baseline to the noise envelope's maximum, ordinary troughs then fired probes, post-revert resamples read elevated, and the flap loop self-sustained every few minutes - dozens of clicks a night. Current contract: raw troughs arm nothing (the EMA smoother sees through them), but the 14a1d61 ratchet ANCHOR is a level test too, so under this much noise the smoothed dips below 97% of the anchor let one probe pair through at each backoff step (x1 then x2 within this hour, converging to one pair per 4h at the cap) - 5 clicks in the first hour, quiet after. That level-not-trend sensitivity is generator E, documented as open; the budget here encodes today's contract, and tightening it is the probe_backoff revisit's job.
